description: Full control over the target object; enables any ACL-based abuse (password reset, shadow creds, RBCD, group add).

telemetry.detail: Directory Service Access on the target object - only if object-level SACL auditing is enabled (default OFF).
Directory service object modified when the abuse writes an attribute (e.g. msDS-KeyCredentialLink, member). Requires DS-change auditing.
The chosen abuse primitive drives the real signal (password reset 4724, shadow-cred write, RBCD). The ACL itself is passive until used.

abuse_primitive: Over a user: targeted Kerberoast or ForceChangePassword or AddKeyCredentialLink. Over a computer: RBCD or shadow credentials. Over a group: AddMember.
notes: Score reflects the quietest common abuse (shadow creds / targeted roast). If abused via password reset treat as ~55. Score climbs sharply if 4662 object auditing is on.
